COURT'S OR JUDGE'S ORDERS
WPMS No. 3332 of 2022
Hon'ble S.K. Mishra, J.
Mr. G.C. Kandpal, learned counsel for the
petitioner.
Mr. Suyash Pant, learned Standing Counsel for
the State.
By filing this writ petition, the petitioner has
prayed for the following relief:
1. "Issue a writ, order or direction in the
nature of certiorari quashing the entire
election process adopted to constitute
the Committee of Management of the
school on 28.04.2022 as well as the
approval granted by the respondent
no. 2 on 27.05.2022.
2. Issue a writ, order or direction in the
nature of mandamus commanding and
directing the respondents to cancel the
approval granted by the respondent
no. 2 to the said Committee of
Management for conducting election
in violations of the provisions of
approved Scheme of Administration
of the school.
3. Issue a writ, order or direction in the
nature of mandamus commanding and
directing the respondents to conduct
the fresh election of the Committee of
Management of the said school as per
the provisions of the approved
Scheme of Administration."
The petitioner himself happens to be a former
member of the Committee of Management, Adarsh
Janta Inter College, Badgal Bhatt in the district of
Almora. However, the grievance is that for
constituting the present Committee of Management
i.e. respondent no. 4 no proper notification was

issued in the newspaper circulated in the district of
Almora and notification was issued in edition of the
Newspaper. Therefore, he prays that the entire
election process should be quashed.
Learned State counsel Mr. Suyash Pant would
however submit that the petitioner has an alternative
and efficacious remedy in the sense that he can
approach the Registrar by filing an appropriate
application under Section 25 of the Societies
Registration Act, 1860, and the Registrar if he finds
any truth in the allegations made by the petitioner
may refer the matter to the prescribed authority.
In that view of the matter, the writ application
is disposed of giving liberty to the petitioner to file
a properly articulated representation to the Registrar
Cooperative Societies by annexing a certified copy
of this order. He is also at liberty to file a proper
document in support of his representation.
On such an event, the Registrar shall consider
the representation of the present petitioner and may
call for the records of the last election, which is
impugned in this writ application and after giving
reasonable opportunity of hearing to the respondent
nos. 4 & 5 shall decide whether to refer the matter
to the prescribed authority for deciding whether the
election are fair and in accordance with law.
The petitioner's counsel undertakes that such
an application may be filed within ten days. The
Registrar shall do well to dispose of the
representation within a time bound period of 30
days from the production of certified copy of this
order.
(S.K. Mishra, J.)
 21.12.2022
 (Grant urgent certified copy as per Rules)
Pooja
